description: A shell script containing tests for Git commands outside a repository, including setup, patch operations, grep, diff, and other Git functionalities, with specific focus on commands executed outside a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success for a given command or set of commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global Git configuration for testing.
